title: Full RPG Wizard Fishing game (lol). Main storyline is 6 hours so far
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hey everyone,

  
After I finished my ARPG game I decided to move on to Pokemon style RPG games, sharing my first version here, which has quite big world already. 

The game is about exploring the Cove, uncovering it's secrets and fishing in the meantime - I've built out fishing game mechanics within the RPG game, as well as cooking, spell crafting and questing

\- Cozy RPG game  
\- 6 hour storyline so far  
\- Mini-games within the game: Fishing, Cooking, Spellcrafting  
\- Everything you see in the game is done with AI, just with prompts, Music too  
\- Built on Tesana in about half a day, and about 30 iterations and prompts so far  


**My first prompt was:**  
*"Build me a top down, pixel-style RPG game where you play as a cute wizard that is on a quest to learn fishing and magic. The world should be large, and player should be able to enter various areas, houses and games with ease. Give me a first version with a town, forest and lake, and a starter quest line in a Wizard tower"*

  
What should I add next?
